overloads.semanticRole: Opens a serial port for communication, optionally passing port settings.

discriminatedBy.rule: First overload: port is a serial port number, opening/configuring that port.

sentinelValues.meaning: closes the currently opened serial port or document

overloads.semanticRole: Performs a document-oriented channel operation (e.g. open/close) on the named document.

discriminatedBy.rule: Second overload: operation is a document-operation code (e.g. 11 closes the current channel), with document naming the target document.

constraints: Only one serial port or one document can be open at a time via this command.
To close a previously opened channel, call SET CHANNEL(11).
